question: Does the nonnegative Int32 field-count mask improve measured performance?

variants.A: current source, masked field increment in both row writing groups
variants.B: remove only & 0x7FFFFFFF from those two increments

plan.B: plain: remove only two field-count masks
plan.scan: 4 ABBA/BAAB blocks each, full/stress in forward and reverse case order
plan.parse: 8 ABBA/BAAB blocks, unmodified benchmark:parse with frozen module routing

full.method: Four ABBA/BAAB blocks, fresh process per observation; fixed predeclared case order. Reused line table in both variants. Each case GC,100ms warmup,GC,50ms settle,200ms natural-GC timing. One operation scans all sizes listed, preserving alternation. Process external/arrayBuffer memory are snapshots, not peak memory or total allocation.
